events.text:
## Recommendation
- Go to the Grand Haven pier. It is the only one of the four with a recent pier-specific report.
- Fish early in the morning with glow spoons, the only pier lure the recent reports mention.
- Expect slow to below-average action at all four piers. None of the recent reports showed a good pier bite.
- Skip Muskegon for now. Its newest report is four weeks old and was slow at the pier.

## Why
- Grand Haven is the only pier with a recent pier report, and it was slow in the newest one, so I'd expect below-average fishing there, not a good bite.
- The early-morning glow spoon catches were the only pier success in the recent reports, so that is the setup I'd bring.
- I'd expect St. Joseph and South Haven to be similar or slower, since their recent reports covered boats and rivers, not piers.
- Upwelling wind has been quiet over the last three days at all four ports, so I'd not expect a fresh cold-water push to the piers this week.

## Evidence
**Recent reports**
- Grand Haven, 2023-09-27: pier action "slow"; "a couple were caught early in the morning while casting glow spoons" (rated 0).
- Grand Haven, 2023-09-20: pier "caught a few salmon while casting glow spoons early in the morning" (rated 1).
- Grand Haven, 2023-09-13: pier anglers with glow spoons caught coho and "a few Chinook" (Chinook rated 1, coho not rated).
- Grand Haven, 2023-09-06: pier "slow" (rated 0).
- South Haven, 2023-09-27 and 2023-09-13: boat and Black River reports only; boats "slow." No pier report.
- St. Joseph, 2023-09-27: boat "slow." Its river report was not rated. No pier report.
- Muskegon, 2023-09-06 (27 days old): pier "slow" on glow spoons (rated 0). No newer report.

**Ratings (my estimates, low confidence)**
- Grand Haven: 1 (below average). Based on the two most recent pier reports.
